periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation with the long axis tilted approximately 60-70 degrees toward the midline of the face.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertical oval with a high aspect ratio where height significantly exceeds width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering observed at the bottom of the patch, shifting the visual mass toward the upper region.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick lateral bands visible where the torso meets the forelimbs, covering approximately 35% of the visible vertical torso profile.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation between ears relative to the total cranial width.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, continuous semi-circular curvature at the top of the pinnae.
